name: dev_notification_delivery
description: Scheduled notification service that distinguishes recipients from a delivery provider.
resource_constraints_text: Deploy on GCP Linux VMs in Seoul using Docker. The monthly budget is 250 USD. One VM is acceptable initially, but notification jobs may burst each morning.

classified.text: Account owners configure which account events should produce notifications.
Account owners select email or SMS as their delivery channel.
When a selected account event occurs, the system asks the external Message Delivery Provider to deliver the notification.
Account owners receive a daily summary of unread account events at 09:00 in their configured time zone.
Support agents inspect the delivery status and failure reason of a notification.
Support agents retry a failed notification through the Message Delivery Provider.
Notification records and delivery attempts shall remain durable across restarts.
Transient provider failures shall be retried for up to 24 hours.
Event-triggered notifications shall be submitted to the provider within 10 seconds.
Provider credentials shall be injected at runtime.
The Docker-based service shall run on Linux VMs and emit structured delivery logs.
